(1) UK financial analysts are more likely than their US counterparts to be influenced by a company’s international operations when revising earnings estimates, (2) US financial analysts are more influenced by management guidance and are more likely to use the same EPS forecast for a company’s fiscal year as they do for the previous fiscal year than their UK counterparts, and (3) UK financial analysts consider more factors to be important than US analysts.
